As such, there is higher expression of IL-2–STAT5 axis target genes and the IL-2 receptor alpha-encoding gene itself (Il2ra) (Guo et al., 2009; Meisel et al., 2001) as well as enhanced tumor necrosis factor receptor 2 (TNF-R2) transcript expression and correspondingly an increased TNF induced expression signature, suggesting stimulation of the cells by TNF (Kumar et al., 1997; Figure 1GH).
evidence: This is a finding from the transcriptome analysis, supported by citations.
